name: 家族が夕ごはんを作るキッチン
description: A family kitchen at dinner time. A woman is putting a frying pan on the counter, and a shopping basket is on the counter too. A girl and a boy are sitting at a table, and a man is carrying a box past the counter. Plates and a bottle are on the table.
